title: OKF v0.2 Note Frontmatter
description: Validation contract for the YAML frontmatter block of a Note in a burlmd Workspace, expressed against the YAML block's decoded mapping. Conformance to Open Knowledge Format v0.2 requires only that the block parse and that `type` be present and non-empty (SPEC.md section 11). Every other property here is either recommended by the specification or tolerated by it; unknown properties MUST be accepted and, per ADR-007, are preserved byte-for-byte on disk rather than round-tripped through this model.

type.description: REQUIRED by OKF section 11.2. A short string identifying the kind of concept. There is no central registry; consumers MUST tolerate unknown types. burlmd writes the constant 'Note' unless a richer type vocabulary is introduced as a product capability.

title.description: RECOMMENDED by OKF section 4.1, not required. Consumers MAY derive a title from the filename when absent. burlmd always writes it, so that a Note's display title is decoupled from its filename and therefore from its identity (ADR-004 decision 3).

description.description: RECOMMENDED by OKF. A single sentence summarizing the concept. burlmd neither writes nor requires this, but preserves it when present.

resource.description: RECOMMENDED by OKF. A URI uniquely identifying the underlying asset. Not meaningful for a personal Note, where the Note is itself the asset; preserved when present.

tags.description: RECOMMENDED by OKF. Short strings for cross-cutting categorization. Preserved when present; not yet surfaced as a product capability.

timestamp.description: OPTIONAL. An ISO 8601 datetime. burlmd does not write this: the authoritative modification time is the Git history, and writing a timestamp into the file body on every save would violate the Edit Fidelity constraint by producing a diff on every write.

status.description: OPTIONAL lifecycle field (OKF section 5.4). Absent is equivalent to 'stable'. Preserved when present; surfacing it is deferred product scope.

stale_after.description: OPTIONAL lifecycle field (OKF section 5.5). An absolute date after which the concept should be treated as potentially outdated.

generated.description: OPTIONAL trust field (OKF section 5.2). Records how the content was produced. Actor identifiers follow OKF section 7: '<producer>/<version>' for tools and agents, 'human:<id>' for people, 'process:<id>' for processes.

verified.description: OPTIONAL trust field (OKF section 5.2). One verification event, or a list of them.

sources.description: OPTIONAL provenance field (OKF section 5.1). Materials the concept derives from.

usage_window.description: OPTIONAL provenance field (OKF section 5.1). Frames the date range that `sources[].usage_count` was measured over.

okf_version.description: OPTIONAL, and valid ONLY in the frontmatter of a bundle-root index.md (OKF section 12). burlmd does not generate index.md (ADR-004 decision 6), so a burlmd-authored bundle never declares this. Listed here so that a bundle authored elsewhere and opened by burlmd validates rather than being rejected.
